name: 04-employee-directory
public_brief: Build/fix an employee directory API: department filter, name search, and sort must match the product spec. Make ./test.sh pass.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: department query param is read but never applied to the queryset
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: When department is non-empty, filter with department__iexact=department.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: q uses exact match name=q instead of name__icontains
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: When q is non-empty, filter with name__icontains=q.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: sort param is ignored; queryset always orders by id
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Honor sort=name|department (default name) via order_by('name') or order_by('department', 'name').
